title: Boundedness above for the direct image of one constructible sheaf
statement: Fix a prime ell, a characteristic-p field k with p prime and p != ell, and separated finite-type k-schemes X and Y with a k-morphism f:X -> Y, in [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. Let Lambda be one of the following condensed coefficient rings: a finite normed ell-adic extension, its integer ring (embedded or closed unit ball), the algebraic closure, or a finite discrete ring killed by an ell-power. Let F be a constructible Lambda_X module, using [sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible] for constructible module objects and [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull] for Rf_*. There is an integer b such that Rf_*(F[0]) lies in D^{<=b}.

source.place: Single-sheaf specialization of integral completion, rationalization and finite-stage descent; finite discrete case: SGA 4½, Th. finitude 1.1; Bhatt--Scholze §§6.7--6.8

proof.text: Case split on the actual IsFinitenessCoefficient constructors. In the finite torsion case, replace the condensed ring by the constant ring via the finite discrete ring isomorphism and encode internal modules as ModuleCat-valued sheaves. Constructibility gives an etale sheaf L. Its single complex has bounded constructible finite-type direct image since ell^n annihilates the coefficients and is invertible in k. The unbounded comparison at L[0] is invertible because it is bounded below. Derive the restriction/pushforward conjugation, transport the bounded direct image through the exact coefficient equivalence and site comparison, and take its upper bound. The n=0 and zero ring cases are covered by exponent one, without nonzero assumptions.

For integral coefficients apply the integral heart bound. The embedded integer ring equals the closed unit ball for the norm induced from Qbar_ell; prove this by equality of subrings. For an arbitrary closed-unit-ball constructor, its defining inequality identifies the same continuous integral coefficient ring. No derived coefficient-realization theorem is needed in this assembly.

For continuous E coefficients obtain an integral SHEAF direct-image model N and its scalar-change isomorphism. Apply the integral heart bound to N. Exactness of integral scalar extension makes its derived functor the termwise derived-category functor, which preserves IsLE b. Transfer the bound along the displayed scalar-change isomorphism.

For algebraic-closure coefficients obtain a finite-field SHEAF N and its direct-image scalar-change isomorphism. Equip E with the norm induced from Qbar_ell and apply the rational case just proved. Exact extension to Qbar_ell preserves IsLE b; transfer through the isomorphism.

proof_origin.place: Sections 5.4, 6.7--6.8; finite torsion proof and exact scalar-extension assembly; three coefficient-specific heart statements remain
